name: Bolt.new Dating App A-Z Build 🤖💘
description_md:
## What You’ll Get

- 📄 Comprehensive Project Deck
A detailed walkthrough of the entire project, from planning to deployment. Understand the step-by-step process to create a dynamic matchmaking app. (PDF - 3 MB)

- 🔧 Make.com Scenarios
Pre-built, sanitized Make.com scenarios for:
- 
Hacky Stripe Payment Automation
Seamlessly handle subscription management and cancellations. (JSON - 22.7 KB)

- 
Firebase Integration Workflow
A ready-to-use database setup for user authentication and subscription tracking. (JSON - 85.9 KB)

- 🎥 Loom Walkthrough Video
A detailed, exclusive behind-the-scenes video walking you through the project setup and technical nuances.

## What You’ll Learn

- Integrating Stripe Payments for subscription management.

- Using Make.com for database triggers and automations.

- Implementing user authentication with Firebase.

- Creating AI-powered matchmaking experiences with Bolt and GPT.

- Designing polished user interfaces and deploying apps on custom domains.
